// diagnostic

E0937

A trait constant name names more than one thing

What

A trait constant name names more than one thing

Why

A trait constant's name names one constant of its trait, and one constant of a type

Fix

Rename the constant so its name names one thing

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0937: tests/ui/trait_constant_name_clash_e0937.stderr.

Error [E0937]: Trait `Shape` has a constant and a method both named `area`
  --> tests/ui/trait_constant_name_clash_e0937.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     area: Float
    |     ^^^^
 Why: `T.area` would name both
 Fix: Rename the constant or the method
